test_title: PYST 61: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 15th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A sum of Rs. 10,000 amounts to Rs. 13,225 in 2 years at a certain rate percent per annum, when the interest is compounded annually. What will be the interest (in Rs.) on the same sum for the same time at the same rate, when the interest is compounded 8-monthly?
solution:
**Given:**

Sum = 10000

Amount = 13225

Time = 2 years

**Formula used:**

A = P(1+ (r)/(100))ⁿt

Where, A = Amount, P = Principal, r = Rate, t = Time

n = Number of times interest is compounded annually

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

Interest is compounded annually

⇒ 13225 = 10000 × {((100 + r)/(100))²}

⇒ 1.3225 = {((100 + r)/(100))²} 

⇒ ​sqrt{1.3225} = {(100 + r)/(100)}​

⇒ 1.15 × 100 = 100 + r

⇒ r = 15%

Again, according to the question,

Interest is compounded 8 monthly

⇒ n = 12/8 = 3/2

⇒ r = large{(15×8)/(12)} = 10%

A = 10000 × {(1 + (10)/(100))⁽⁽³⁾/⁽²⁾times ²⁾}

⇒ A = 10000 × {(1 + (10)/(100))³}

⇒ A = 10000 × (110)/(100) × (110)/(100) × (110)/(100) = 13310

CI = 13310 - 10000 = 3310

**∴ The interest on 10000 for 2 years at the rate of 15%, interest compounded 8 monthly will be Rs 3310.**
